title: Royal Queen Trap
prompt: White to move. Capture the exposed queen with your rook.
explanation: The rook controls the d-file and can take the undefended queen on d5.

title: Diagonal Strike
prompt: White to move. Use your bishop to capture the rook.
explanation: The c4–f7 diagonal is clear, letting the bishop win the rook.

title: Knight's Leap
prompt: White to move. Your knight can win the queen.
explanation: Knights jump in an L shape. From f3 the knight captures on e5.

title: Crown the Pawn
prompt: White to move. Promote the pawn to a queen.
explanation: The pawn reaches its final rank and becomes a queen.

title: The Four-Move Trap
prompt: Black to move. Find checkmate in one.
explanation: Qh4# attacks the exposed white king through the weakened diagonal.
